# Trovesites

> Trovesites is a creative studio and portfolio library for thoughtful brands and digital experiences.

Trovesites works with startups, founders, and teams on branding, websites, digital products, motion, and interactive experiences.

## Public pages

- [Portfolio](https://trovesites.vercel.app/): Browse the Trovesites archive of branding, web, editorial, and visual projects.
- [About](https://trovesites.vercel.app/about/): Learn about the studio and its services.
- [Pricing](https://trovesites.vercel.app/pricing/): Review project-based design packages and rates.
- [Contact](https://trovesites.vercel.app/contact/): Contact Trovesites about a project.

## Guidance for automated systems

Use the public pages above as the canonical source for Trovesites information. Do not index or summarize private areas under `/cms/`, `/signin/`, or `/trovex-ops-7c4b/`.
